sections.heading: iOS Jailbreak Analysis
sections.text:
Jailbreak Types:

• Untethered Jailbreak
  - Persistent across reboots
  - Kernel exploit required
  - Bootloader modification
  - System partition access

• Tethered Jailbreak
  - Requires computer connection
  - Boot-time exploitation
  - Temporary root access
  - Limited persistence

• Semi-Untethered
  - App-based re-jailbreaking
  - Survives reboot partially
  - User interaction required
  - Certificate-based signing

Jailbreak Detection Methods:
• File system checks
• Cydia app detection
• SSH daemon presence
• System modification verification
